prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Create an App in Tableau's Exchange
We are looking for an experienced app developer who has built apps in the Tableau Exchange, a marketplace for Tableau users to find and buy apps. We're looking to expose explicit, existing, functionality from our product to Tableau users. If successful, this person will could continue to help build apps for our product on Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.
</job>

engagement: fixed

Style:

- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Snowflake cost audit (p13).

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need an experienced app developer to expose existing product functionality to Tableau Exchange users, and I can help with that. I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’ve worked on a Snowflake cost audit for a confidential fintech client, where I found the most expensive scheduled queries and warehouses and rewrote or resized them, reducing monthly credits by 34%. That project required careful analysis of existing functionality and turning it into clear, usable outputs for stakeholders.

If you’re looking to build an app for Tableau Exchange and then expand to Microsoft, Databricks, or Snowflake, I can help shape the data logic, reporting experience, and dashboard behavior so it’s practical for Tableau users.
